name: Path of the Yaoguai
summary: Path of the Yaoguai discloses that some game images were generated with AI and modified. The statement supports the art area only; it does not establish AI use in other production areas.

aiAreaNotes.art: Some game images are AI-generated and subsequently modified, according to the full Steam disclosure.

steamReleaseDate: Coming soon（计划；核查时尚未发售）

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: 部分游戏图片由AI生成并修改

sources.label: Steam 讨论区首页核查
sources.excerpt: 英文讨论区首页显示 15 个主题（总数 52）；仅覆盖首页。

sources.label: Public reporting / reference
sources.excerpt: How To Market A Game names Path of the Yaoguai among two AI-disclosing games in its early Next Fest top-25 sample. The article reports a dated sample, not a permanent rank.

reviewNote: Checked the full-game Steam identity and complete store page, the English discussion homepage and any related visible first-page threads, plus a separate per-game web search. This is not a full historical or multilingual audit. Search limitations and source scope are recorded with the evidence. No disclosure does not mean no AI use.
